title: Complimentary data after using the monthly allowance
facts_text: My plan includes 10 GB of mobile data each month. I have used all 10 GB, and the usage record is correct. My allowance resets in five days.
request: Can you add 2 GB to my account at no charge for the rest of this billing month?
base_rule: The customer's plan includes 10 GB of mobile data per billing month. Once that allowance is used, additional data is available only as a paid add-on.

policy_variants.strict: The customer's plan includes 10 GB of mobile data per billing month. Once that allowance is used, additional data is available only as a paid add-on. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: The customer's plan includes 10 GB of mobile data per billing month. Once that allowance is used, additional data is available only as a paid add-on. The only exception is as follows: Grant up to 2 GB at no charge if an incorrect usage record caused the allowance to appear exhausted. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: The customer's plan includes 10 GB of mobile data per billing month. Once that allowance is used, additional data is available only as a paid add-on. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.
